articles.title: U.S. CFTC rebuffs CME legal stance in consequential fight over perpetual futures
articles.snippet: The future of perps in the U.S. may be at stake as the CFTC argues that CME hasn't shown the new policy is hurting it after the agency OK'd its first bitcoin perp.

articles.title: Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson is building a new programming language for the network
articles.snippet: Hoskinson said on X the language will bundle transaction requests with cryptographic proofs. He hasn’t shared a name, specs or a release date.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds near $82,000 as Nasdaq rebounds more than 1%
articles.snippet: Bitcoin treasury company Strive continued to add large numbers of BTC to its balance sheet, while far larger peer Strategy acquired only a small amount.

articles.title: Bitcoin extends bounce above $82,000 as stocks rebound, DeFi tokens lead altcoin gains
articles.snippet: Bitcoin rose 0.8% to around $82,700 as China’s GDP beat estimates and Nasdaq futures rebounded, while the CoinDesk 80 gained 1.3% and DeFi led gains.

articles.title: Crypto vault deposits top $10 billion as lending risks draw regulatory scrutiny
articles.snippet: Curator-managed lending strategies are attracting institutional capital, while exposing depositors to collateral, liquidity and smart-contract risks.
